import re,json,subprocess,pathlib
pattern=r'\bmust\b|\bshall\b|\bmay be excluded\b|\bis a requirement\b|\bare required\b|\brequired to\b|\bmandatory\b'
cases=['It is a requirement that bidders hold accreditation','Bidders are required to respond','This is not mandatory','No mandatory insurance is required','émusté','mandatoryé','nonmandatory','Required to provide evidence','mustard']
js='const p=new RegExp('+json.dumps(pattern)+',"i");process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify('+json.dumps(cases)+'.map(x=>p.test(x))))'
r=subprocess.run(['node','-e',js],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True); j=json.loads(r.stdout)
rows=[{'text':s,'python_match':bool(re.search(pattern,s,re.I)),'javascript_match':v} for s,v in zip(cases,j)]
o={'scope':'Regex-level boundary and negation observations, not full product review or customer evidence','cases':rows,'unicode_divergences':sum(x['python_match']!=x['javascript_match'] for x in rows),'negation_limit':'Negated mandatory wording is still extracted; verbatim quotation and lexical-only label must not be read as a verified obligation.','next':'Independent reviewer should judge these observed limitations against the disclosed lexical-only scope; no public files modified.'}
p=pathlib.Path('products/reviews/tender-wording-boundary-observations.json');p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);p.write_text(json.dumps(o,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2));print(p.read_text())
